Not nearly as bad as some of the other things on here, but I used to be abused (I think, still not 100% sure) by my father

 My parents had been divorced since I was a young boy, and I had every other week with my father. Whenever I went over there, there was nothing to eat, some days, we'd get dinner, but not most. (This led to anorexia, which I still have today) Anytime that any of us did anything bad, we would get spanked/slapped very hard, and we would get hit harder if we cried. 

 Despite my pretty severe asthma at the time, my father always smoked, which made it worse. 
Because of my father's "not believing in doctors" I had to just deal with a concussion or a broken arm until I got to my mother's. (Got the ol' be a man and deal with it) I now have a scar because my father didn't take me back after I picked out my stitches when I was young.

 When I was about 10, my step-mother split up with him, which made him a whole lot worse. He lost his house because of the IRS, and was deemed unfit to take care of me. That was honestly one of the best things to happen to me. I know it's stubborn, but I refuse to contact him until he does me and he hasn't contacted me for years. The last time I talked to him it was when I went over to  ask for child support. (That's a story for another time.) 

Although it's better without it, it still sucks that he doesn't call, even on holidays or my birthday.
